title: Influcoder: Distilling Decoders' Gradient Influence Rankings into an Encoder for Data Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2606.13668v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: With the growth of LLMs' (Large Language Models) capabilities, there has been an increasing push to curate high quality datasets by filtering samples in the training data. In general, Data Attribution (DA) methods aim to estimate how individual samples in a training dataset can precondition a model to generate certain outputs. As an example, one might be interested in which samples in the data could be the source of toxic behavior after training the LLM. Many methods quantify this conditioning through the paradigm of influence functions. While methods of this family are effective in its function, they lack the necessary processing speed and storage compactness to be practically implemented on large datasets. We propose a method, Influcoder, as a quick and cost-effective approach to influence-based Data Attribution at scale.

translated_title: Influcoder：将解码器的梯度影响力排序蒸馏到编码器中以实现数据归因
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）能力的不断增强，人们越来越倾向于通过过滤训练数据中的样本来构建高质量数据集。总体而言，数据归因方法旨在估计训练数据集中的单个样本如何预先决定模型生成特定输出的倾向。例如，人们可能想知道在训练大语言模型后，数据中的哪些样本可能成为毒性行为的来源。许多方法通过影响函数的范式来量化这种条件作用。虽然这类方法在功能上是有效的，但它们缺乏在大型数据集上实际应用所需的处理速度和存储紧凑性。我们提出了一种名为Influcoder的方法，作为一种快速且经济高效的大规模基于影响的数据归因方法。
tldr: Influcoder通过将解码器的梯度影响力排序蒸馏到编码器中，实现了快速且低成本的规模化数据归因。
en_tdlr: Influcoder distills decoders' gradient influence rankings into an encoder, enabling fast and cost-effective influence-based data attribution at scale.
